elements.name: Keep a pinned constraint expansion across sketch edit

steps.name: the MCAD Software has an active part containing an existing sketch
the full Sketch ribbon is visible outside sketch edit
the user opens the Constrain panel additional area
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable
the user clicks the unavailable Edit Coordinate System command
the additional area remains open and no command starts
the user pins the additional area
the user opens the existing sketch for editing
the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are available
the user finishes the sketch without editing it
the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable
